name: 60022 · Glencoe, IL
findings: ZIP 60022 (Glencoe) has 96 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60022 (Glencoe) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60022 (Glencoe) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 18% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
